resolution: Investigated the 'restarted, still doesn't work' report for the custom-floor drag-paint. Pulled the user's ACTUAL cooked-asset store: studio.thin_floor's descriptor IS correctly tagged buildPlacement:{pieceKind:'floor',snap:'grid'}. Confirmed the stream reducer stores the whole descriptor on load (buildPlacement survives), and reproduced the resolution with that EXACT descriptor through the real catalog code — catalogPieceFamily('prop.studio.thin_floor')='floor', it lands in the floor tab and not props. So the data is correct AND the req_1944 gate code is provably correct on the real data; user is on dev+auto-push so my code is running. The failure is therefore narrow (paint execution for a cooked floor, or a runtime descriptor-load gap) and not visible from reading. Ruled out a stale binary (user confirmed dev). Landed a one-press diagnostic (6705d0759, req_1955) logging the armed piece's entry.kind/family/paintKind to split the diagnosis; awaiting the user's [paintdbg] line + whether thin_floor shows in the Floor vs Props tab.
